stem.text: The diagrams show the result of incubating two species of bacteria, P and R, on separate Petri dishes each containing nutrient agar.
Three filter paper discs have been added to each Petri dish.

stem.alt: Petri dish containing bacteria P, with three filter paper discs labelled N, X and Y. The dish is labelled bacteria P.
Petri dish containing bacteria R, with three filter paper discs labelled N, X and Y. The dish is labelled bacteria R.

A.text: Antibiotics X and Y are resistant to bacteria P.

B.text: Bacteria P are resistant to both antibiotics.

C.text: Bacteria R have a mutation that makes them resistant to antibiotic Y.

D.text: N is a control disc showing bacteria R grow when antibiotic Y is not present.
